Name: Fishing in Peace
Author: hsyplayday
Description:
OVERVIEW

No monster damage while you fish. The protection window starts the moment you press the
cast button (including the power meter) and ends when the catch animation finishes, plus
a one-second grace period after you reel in.

Outside that window nothing changes. Walking around with a rod, mining, fighting: monsters
hurt you exactly as they always did. This is not a god mode.

Works with or without Stardew Valley Expanded.


WHY THIS EXISTS

While playing with Stardew Valley Expanded, I kept fishing in the Highlands and other
monster-heavy maps. Killing the monsters did not help: they respawn fast enough that I could
never fish in peace. Fishing is also the one situation where the game takes away your ability
to move, so you cannot run, dodge or fight back. I wanted something that covered exactly that
situation and nothing else.


MAIN FEATURES

- Immune to monster damage from the moment you cast until the catch animation ends, with a
  configurable grace period afterwards.
- Projectile damage (slime spit, fireballs) is covered as well.
- Three protection scopes plus a master switch, so you can narrow or disable it at any time.
- English and Chinese interface, independent of the game's own language.
- No new items, no textures, no dependencies beyond SMAPI. Generic Mod Config Menu optional.


HOW IT WORKS

A single Harmony prefix on Farmer.takeDamage. While the player is fishing, the original method
never runs, so there is no health loss, no knockback, no hit sound, no invincibility frames
consumed and no faint check. No game files are modified: removing the folder restores vanilla
behaviour, and your save is untouched.

The window follows the rod's own state, not a timer, a location or a key press. That matters
because during a cast the movement keys are used to adjust where the line lands, so movement
input cannot be used as a signal.


CONFIGURATION

With Generic Mod Config Menu installed, settings appear under Settings > Mod Options.
Otherwise edit config.json in the mod folder.

- Protection scope: Standard / Strict / Relaxed / Off
- Grace period: seconds of protection after reeling in (default 1)
- Block unattributed damage: also block damage that reports no source, i.e. projectiles
  (default on)
- Verbose log: write every blocked hit to the SMAPI log
- Language: English (default) or Chinese


INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS

1. Install SMAPI 4.5.2 or newer.
2. Unzip into your Mods folder so that you have Mods/FishingInPeace/manifest.json
3. Launch the game through SMAPI.

On startup the SMAPI log should contain a line ending in [ACTIVE]. If it says [NOT ACTIVE],
the same log explains why. Please include those lines when reporting a problem.


REQUIREMENTS

Required:
- SMAPI 4.5.2 or newer
- Stardew Valley 1.6

Optional:
- Generic Mod Config Menu - only needed for the in-game settings menu.
  Without it, edit config.json manually.


KNOWN LIMITATIONS

- It does not stop monsters from approaching. They still crowd you and make noise; they
  simply cannot hurt you.
- Debuffs are applied inside the same method as damage, so darkness and slowness are blocked
  in the base game. Other mods may apply them through a separate path; that is not verified.
- Projectile blocking is on by default but has not been tested in-game against a live
  projectile. If a ranged attack still hurts you while fishing, please report it.
- Multiplayer has not been tested.
- May interact with other mods that also patch damage handling. If something looks wrong,
  please attach your SMAPI log.


TESTED WITH

Stardew Valley 1.6.15, SMAPI 4.5.2, Windows, alongside Stardew Valley Expanded.


AI DISCLOSURE

This mod is labelled AI Generated Content. Here is exactly what that means.

Written by AI: the C# source code, the README, and the first draft of this page description.

Written by the human author: the problem definition, every design decision (the protection
window, the three modes, the grace period, the "only while fishing" boundary), the naming,
all in-game testing, and every decision made in response to review feedback, including the
projectile fix in 1.0.1.

Verification: technical claims about the game's internals were checked against the actual
Stardew Valley 1.6 assembly metadata rather than assumed, then confirmed in-game. Tested
behaviour: no damage, knockback or hit sound while fishing; damage resuming about one second
after reeling in; normal damage outside fishing unaffected. Full source is on the Files tab.

No third-party assets are used. The mod adds no art, audio, voices or translations, and
contains no AI-generated media of any kind.


中文说明

钓鱼期间免疫怪物伤害。保护窗口从按下抛竿开始（包含蓄力条），到收鱼动画结束，再加收竿后
1 秒宽限。窗口之外一切照旧：举着鱼竿走路、下矿、打怪，怪物照样伤到你。这不是无敌模式。

做这个 mod 的原因：玩 SVE 时在高地等地图钓鱼，怪物刷新太快，杀掉也没用，一直没法安静钓。
而且钓鱼恰好是游戏里唯一"你不能移动"的状态——跑不掉、闪不了、也还不了手。想要的就是覆盖
这一段，别的都不碰。

实现方式：在 Farmer.takeDamage 上加一个 Harmony prefix，钓鱼状态下直接返回，原方法不执行。
不修改任何游戏文件，删掉文件夹即恢复原样。不需要 Content Patcher，不新增物品和贴图。

配置项：保护范围（标准/严格/宽松/关闭）、收竿后宽限秒数、是否拦截来源未知的伤害、
详细日志、界面语言（英文/中文，默认英文）。

已知限制：不阻止怪物靠近；负面状态在其他 mod 的独立路径下可能仍会生效；投射物拦截默认开启
但未经实测；多人模式未测试；与同样修改受伤逻辑的 mod 可能冲突，遇到问题请附 SMAPI 日志。

实测环境：星露谷 1.6.15 / SMAPI 4.5.2 / Windows，与 SVE 同时运行。
